title: Praça Amarela

subtitle.pt: Ambiente 3D com materiais toon, em equipa de quatro
subtitle.en: 3D environment with toon materials, in a team of four

author: Arthur Brabo da Silva Cruz

myRole.pt: O meu papel: look dev dos materiais toon e iluminação
myRole.en: My role: toon material look dev and lighting

summary.pt: Praça urbana estilizada com shading toon de dois tons e contornos por normal-outline. Fiz o look dev dos materiais e a iluminação; a modelação foi da equipa.
summary.en: A stylised urban square with two-tone toon shading and normal-based outlines. I did the material look dev and lighting; the modelling was the team's.

en.heading: Brief and constraints
en.text: A group brief: build a readable urban environment with a flat, illustrative look. My scope was narrow and explicit — make the shading system and light the scene. I did not model the buildings, the props or the foliage.

en.heading: The problem
en.text: Two-tone toon shading collapses in a scene with many light sources: everything reads as one flat mass. I locked the scene to a single key light plus a coloured bounce, and pushed separation into the outline width instead of into the shading.
